title: Heat Pump
description: Clock-synced sidechain ducking: hold + log release
text:
Heat Pump is a clock-synced sidechain ducking envelope: on each division the CV ducks, holds briefly, then recovers with a logarithmic release. Patch CV Out to a filter or VCA; MIDI CC mirrors when Out is enabled.

Main sets release speed. Shift + fader sets depth. Button + fader picks clock division. Short tap triggers one manual duck. Long press mutes without snapping to idle. Shift + long toggles invert.

channels.jackDescription: CV Out = duck envelope; CV In modulates Depth, Release, or triggers Duck.

title: Grooves
description: Multi-genre MIDI drum grooves with feel
text: Grooves is a one-channel multi-genre drum helper with up to seven MIDI voices clock-synced in 4/4. **Groove** picks the genre family; **Density** and **Feel** shape fills and character; **Drummer** personas (long press) change ornament style. Swing depth is capped by **Swing max %** (sign = direction). Jack modes include Any/Stacked CV out and CV in for Density, Feel, or Reset. Clock-driven scheduling stays in a dedicated processor; MIDI sends run in a separate task (`pending_*` isolation).

channels.jackDescription: Any: velocity-weighted pulse per hit. Stacked: 1 V kick, 2 V snare, 4 V hats.
channels.faderDescription: Reveals extra drum hits as ghosts.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: reverse swing. Long: Any vs Stacked.

title: Volata
description: Staccato melody bursts in device key — always newly generated, always harmonic
text:
Volata fires short, staccato melody bursts in the device key. Each burst is generated on the fly with functional harmony — weighted I, vi, ii, V plus IV and iii — and never repeats the same contour twice.

Rhythm is mixed: 16ths, 8ths, dotted 8ths and quarters, with rests as first-class events (offbeats rest more often). Length is still a 16th-slot budget; the generator packs duration cells into that budget.

**Gate %** is relative to each sounding note’s duration, not to a fixed 16th slot — 50% on a quarter is two 16ths of gate, 50% on a 16th is half a slot. Rests ignore gate. Pitch CV drops with note-off.

**Ch0 short** mutes both channels and dims the LEDs. **Ch1 short** triggers one burst immediately and cuts any burst in progress. With the clock running, events land on the sixteenth grid; when stopped, sixteenths run at ~125 ms (120 BPM fallback).

Auto-fire happens on bar downbeat (`tick % 96 == 0`) when unmuted and the gap (in sixteenth slots) has elapsed. Gap 0 means the next bar.

**Note** mode walks a monophonic chord-tone line with passing and neighbor tones. **Chord** arpeggiates the triad. **Voicings** picks close, 1st inversion, 2nd inversion, or drop-2 spread per burst.

CV In on Ch0 (Length / Gap / Gate) and Pitch CV Out on Ch1 follow Range and V/Oct. Follow device tonic and Follow device scale tie into the global quantizer; long-press Ch0 cycles the local Scale set when scale isn’t followed.

Clock drain is isolate-safe (`clock_drain` / `glob_ticks` only — no `clock_ticker`).

channels.jackDescription: ±5 V input modulates Length, Gap, or Gate per CV Dest param.
channels.faderDescription: Number of sixteenth-note slots per burst (1–32).
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Sixteenth slots between auto-fired bursts (0–96; 0 = next bar).
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Gate as % of that note’s duration (16th / 8th / dotted 8th / quarter). Rests ignore gate.
channels.fnDescription: Short: mute. Long: cycle Scale set.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Long press with Shift cycles Scale backward.
channels.ledTop: Main: burst progress while gated. Alt: white fader meter. Third: scale-color fader meter
channels.ledTopPlusShift: Alt layer — white Top/Bottom split of gap fader
channels.ledTopPlusFn: Third layer — scale-color Top/Bottom split of gate% fader
channels.ledBottom: Pairs with Top as the low half of the latch meter; off on Main when idle

channels.jackDescription: 1V/oct pitch of the current note (Range + V/Oct params).
channels.faderDescription: Melodic center around Base Note, ±4 octaves.
channels.fnDescription: Short: fire burst now. Long: cycle Note → Chord → Voicings.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Long press with Shift cycles voicing backward.
channels.ledTop: Main: pitch height while gated. Alt: white fader meter. Third: voicing-color fader meter
channels.ledTopPlusShift: Alt layer — white Top/Bottom split of range fader
channels.ledTopPlusFn: Third layer — voicing-color Top/Bottom split of velocity fader
channels.ledBottom: Pairs with Top as the low half of the latch meter; off on Main when idle
